sections.Profile:
The "Race Time" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1959, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, featuring artwork by Roy Parker. The machine includes four flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, three gobble holes, and three standup targets.
